description: Runs Essentia audio analysis (segment boundaries, beats, BPM) on the project's audio files - or one standalone audio file - and caches the results next to the project for auto_edit/assemble to use. Fails with essentia_unavailable in builds without Essentia.

target.description: A .audium project package or a single audio file

types.description: Comma-separated analysis types, e.g. "sbic,beat_degara" (default: the merge set)

name: analyze
title: Analyze audio
